<js>
url=baseUrl.replace(/$/,"?a=1");
head=JSON.parse(source.header);
jso=JSON.parse(java.get(url,head).body());
json=jso.txt;
var uniString = JSON.stringify(json);
var chString = unescape(uniString.replace(/\\u/g, '%u'));
html=chString.replace(/\\r/g,'').replace(/^"/,'').replace(/"$/,'');
html;
</js>
